begin_message: Thanks for calling {{company_name}}, this is {{agent_name}}. How can I help?

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: Hang up. Use after the goodbye, after taking a warranty-company message, or right after saying "Sorry, I can't help you with that." to a spam caller.

general_tools.name: book_service_call
general_tools.description: Book a repair visit. Call once, only after the intake details are in and, for a standard job, the caller clearly accepted the $99 service call fee. Never for warranty-company reps, spam, or callback messages. Relay only the returned `say`; it is booked only if `result` is `booked`.
general_tools.execution_message_description: One moment while I book that.

job_type.description: warranty only when the caller said the appliance is under the manufacturer's warranty; otherwise standard.

phone.description: Confirmed callback number, digits only with country code, e.g. +15125550142.

service_address.description: Confirmed service address: street, unit, city.

appliance_type.description: The appliance, e.g. dryer, refrigerator, dishwasher.

brand.description: Appliance brand as the caller said it.

issue.description: What is wrong, in the caller's words, short.

fee_accepted.description: true only after the caller heard and accepted the $99 fee; leave out for warranty.

notes.description: Anything else useful: model number, error code, access notes, other appliances, questions for the team.
